_about: Fixed ask-mode test set, written before the evaluation runs. Kept outside vault/ so retrieval can never find the answer key.

ask_tests.question: What mean evaluation score did my trained Ms. Pac-Man agent reach, and what was the untrained baseline?
ask_tests.expected_passage: Headline / evaluation table: mean score 492.0 (untrained network) -> 876.0 after 1,000 training games (+384.0).

ask_tests.question: Why did my handwritten-digit classifier stop working when the digits were moved over by a few pixels?
ask_tests.expected_passage: Section 4, Shift experiment: accuracy 91.5% at 0 px falls to 11.5% at 5 px; the model has one weight per pixel position, so moving the ink puts every weight in the wrong place.

ask_tests.question: What learning rate did I choose for the Pac-Man DQN, and what learning rate did I choose for the custom LLM?
ask_tests.expected_source: vault/raw/Pac-Man DQN Project.md + vault/raw/Custom LLM Project.md
ask_tests.expected_passage: Pac-Man 'My three settings': learning rate 0.0002. Custom LLM 'My choices and prediction': learning rate 0.001 (a peak, with 100-step warmup and cosine decay).

ask_tests.question: How much did I pay for cloud GPU time to train the custom LLM?
ask_tests.expected_passage: No source states a price or a cloud GPU rental. The LLM README records CPU training with no CUDA, which is not a cost figure.
